A.quote: AWS Directory Service will provide a customer-specific URL for the AWS Management Console which users can use to sign in with their existing corporate credentials.

B.quote: Before you can grant console access to your directory members, your directory must have an access URL.

C.quote: To use permission sets, you'll need to use an Organization instance of IAM Identity Center.

D.quote: This makes it easy for you to grant your users access to the AWS Management Console without needing to configure and manage a separate SAML infrastructure.
